hooks.command: [ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] || exit 0; hc get "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.labels["herdr.space"] // empty' | { read -r s && herdr-app ls 2>/dev/null | jq -r --arg s "$s" --arg c "${PWD##*/}" '.spaces[] | select(.id == $s and (.name == (.folder | rtrimstr("/") | split("/") | last) or .name == $c)) | "Name your Herdr space after this prompt, without mentioning it: herdr-app do space.rename --id \(.id) --name <label>"'; }; exit 0

[ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] || exit 0; l=$(hc get "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" 2>/dev/null | jq -c '.labels // {}'); [ -n "$l" ] || exit 0; set -- $(jq -r --argjson l "$l" '.prompt // "" | (select(($l.ticket // "") == "") | first(capture("linear\\.app/[^/\\s]+/issue/(?<id>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{1,4}-[0-9]{1,6})"; "g")) | "ticket=" + (.id | ascii_upcase)), (select(($l.pr // "") == "") | first(scan("https://github\\.com/[^/\\s]+/[^/\\s]+/pull/[0-9]+")) | "pr=" + .)'); [ $# -gt 0 ] && hc label "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
t=$(ps -o tty= -p $PPID | tr -d ' '); case $t in ''|'??') exit 0;; esac; printf '\033[4 q' > /dev/$t 2>/dev/null; exit 0
